races.title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A typically interesting novice for the track with AQUA BLEU selected to come out on top. Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o boasts plenty of experience having scored 3 times in junior hurdles last season and with his Aintree reappearance second under his belt, he's interesting now tackling a longer trip. Well Achieved landed his only start in points and is respected, with recent course runner up Sappingirl and returning Trial by Jury others commanding plenty of respect. AQUA BLEU (IRE) WELL ACHIEVED (IRE) SAPPINGIRL (IRE)

races.title: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FAIRY PARK seems a bit of an edgy sort but she looked a good prospect on the evidence of her 2 bumper efforts last season, which she duly confirmed when hammering a next-time-out winner on her Ffos Las hurdling debut, and strikes as the type to go on to much better things. Expensive point recruit Royal Response impressed over C&D earlier in the month and is open to plenty of improvement, too, while the scopey Ti'mamzel shouldn't be taken lightly as a dual listed bumper winner. FAIRY PARK (IRE) ROYAL RESPONSE (IRE) TI'MAMZEL (FR)

races.verdict: This looks ultra competitive with the progressive NORN IRON topping the shortlist having prevented a Willie Mullins 1-2-3 when second at the Punchestown Festival. This test could be ideal for Jipcot , while Venetia Williams saddles a couple of interesting runners in Demnat and Holetown . NORN IRON (IRE) JIPCOT (FR) DEMNAT (FR)

races.title: Coral 'Bet10 Get50 Sign Up Offer' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GENTLEMAN TOBOOT looks well treated on his strong novice hurdle form and appeals most at the prices. Dan Skelton's Moneygarrow will rightly be popular in the market, and he's feared most ahead of strong-travelling Spirits Bay . Court In The Act and A King Of Magic complete the shortlist for this competitive renewal. GENTLEMAN TOBOOT (IRE) MONEYGARROW (IRE) SPIRITS BAY

races.title: Coral Racing Club Intermediate Handicap Hurdle (Reg' As The Gerry Feilden) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A good-looking renewal of the Gerry Feilden. IDAHO SUN was seen to better effect than subsequent Supreme third Mydaddypaddy when accounting for him in the Grade 1 Formby at Aintree when last seen, but that form still makes him look well treated from an opening mark in the early 140s, so there's every reason to believe he can maintain his unbeaten record over hurdles. Mondo Man is well worth another chance given the strength of his Imperial Cup win, with The Mighty Celt completing the shortlist. IDAHO SUN (IRE) MONDO MAN THE MIGHTY CELT (IRE)

races.title: Coral Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Registered As The Newbury Gold Cup) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WENDIGO got away without his handicap mark going up for his Carlisle reappearance success, a move which could prove lenient based on what was a clear career best on Timeform ratings. This 7-y-o should prove capable of even better now stepping back up in trip and can provide his stable with a second recent win in this. Regent's Stroll , whose novice form ties in with recent Paddy Power victor Meetmebythesea, Road To Home and Miami Magic are feared most in that order. WENDIGO (FR) REGENT'S STROLL (IRE) ROAD TO HOME (IRE)

races.title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WRECKLESS ERIC made a promising start in this sphere when runner-up at Ffos Las and can build on it to go one better off a handy-looking mark here. Last year's victor Ryan's Rocket is also of interest off his current mark and rates a big threat though, while both Un Sens A La Vie and Largy Belter command plenty of respect with better days still ahead. Pure Carbon and The Four Sixes complete the shortlist in this cracking handicap. WRECKLESS ERIC RYAN'S ROCKET (IRE) UN SENS A LA VIE (FR)
